scope: Locked source and linker-policy inspection only. This record does not execute or install any binary, download a delivery artifact, or change the running build.

source.observation: desktop::build sets STATIC_VCRUNTIME=true before spawning the production Cargo build unless the inherited value is exactly false.

sources.observation: For target_env=msvc and STATIC_VCRUNTIME=true, try_build calls static_vcruntime::build.
Overrides Rust's msvcrt.lib, excludes dynamic vcruntime/default CRT variants, and selects libcmt.lib, libvcruntime.lib and ucrt.lib.
MSVC bindings use link(name=WebView2LoaderStatic, kind=static); the WebView2Loader.dll link is selected only for non-MSVC targets.
Copies the bundled libraries into OUT_DIR and adds the target-architecture directory to the native linker search path.

x64StaticLoader.inspection: Read-only strings scan of the packaged archive observed explicit DEFAULTLIB directives for ole32.lib and uuid.lib. This is supporting input inspection, not a final executable import table.

projectConnection.buildCommand: pnpm --filter @milkup/desktop exec tauri build --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --bundles nsis --config scripts/ci/tauri-mermaid-trial.json --ci -- --locked
projectConnection.observation: The Windows branch calls tauri_build::try_build even when replacing Tauri's default manifest handling. The new workflow invokes Tauri CLI production build and does not set STATIC_VCRUNTIME=false.
projectConnection.installedRuntimePolicy: scripts/ci/tauri-mermaid-trial.json sets webviewInstallMode.type=skip. The installed-product harness selects an existing machine Evergreen Runtime; no Runtime installation or Fixed Runtime fallback is authorized by this proof.

interpretation.conclusion: Absence of a project crt-static Cargo setting or explicit workflow STATIC_VCRUNTIME=true does not imply a new VC redistributable prerequisite: the locked Tauri CLI supplies the static-vcruntime policy by default.
interpretation.condition: An inherited STATIC_VCRUNTIME value exactly equal to false would opt out. The source inspection does not capture the remote job's complete inherited environment.
interpretation.ucrt: This policy statically links the VC runtime/startup but intentionally uses ucrt.lib, the import library for Windows UCRT, rather than statically linking the whole CRT.
interpretation.ucrtReferenceObservation: Microsoft documents libvcruntime.lib as static, ucrt.lib as importing ucrtbase.dll, and UCRT as a Windows component included in Windows 10 and later.
interpretation.webview: The loader's static linkage does not bundle the Evergreen browser runtime; the existing-runtime prerequisite remains.
